headline: Iran escalates attacks after US strike on Larak Island and targets bases in the region
summary: Iran said it targeted a military base in the UAE and shot down a US drone over the Strait of Hormuz. The move follows US airstrikes on Iranian sites.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil, so military escalation there directly affects energy markets.
why_moved: Escalating Iran-US military exchanges around the Strait of Hormuz raise the risk to Gulf oil shipments.
